track: STEM first-year university mathematics (Slovak/Czech: prvý ročník vysokoškolská matematika)
notes: Day units are learning-days (~30 min core, optional bonus), not calendar days. A future AI session should read this file first to find the right chapter file before reading any chapter content directly.

modules.title: Foundations Bridge
modules.description: Targets diagnosed gaps directly: arithmetic care, exponent laws, factoring, rational expressions, and solving equations rigorously. Sized for 'rusty, not beginner.'

days.title: Exponent Laws I — Product & Quotient Rules
Exponent Laws II — Power Rules, Zero & Negative Exponents
Factoring I — GCF & Difference of Squares
Rational Expressions II — Multiply, Divide, Add, Subtract
Solving Quadratics — Factoring, Completing the Square, the Formula
Module 0 Capstone — Mixed Review & Diagnostic Retake
days.core: Complete the interleaved review set (all of Module 0).
days.bonus: Retake the original diagnostic problems and compare.

modules.title: Functions & Graphs
modules.description: Function notation, domain/range, transformations, piecewise, composition, inverse functions. Currently zero prior knowledge — built from scratch; this is the backbone skill for everything after.

modules.title: Trigonometry
modules.description: Unit circle, radians, exact values, graphs of sin/cos/tan, identities, solving trig equations. Builds on existing wave/physics intuition.

modules.title: Exponentials & Logarithms
modules.description: Exponential growth/decay, log laws, change of base, solving exp/log equations.

modules.title: Logic & Proof Foundations
modules.description: Propositional logic (∧ ∨ ¬ ⇒ ⇔), quantifiers (∀ ∃), set notation (∈ ⊆ ∩ ∪), direct/contrapositive/contradiction proofs, induction. Maps directly onto existing boolean logic-gate fluency.

modules.title: Calculus I — Limits & Continuity
modules.description: Intuitive and formal limits, limit laws, continuity, asymptotes.

modules.title: Calculus I — Derivatives & Rules
modules.description: Definition of the derivative, power/product/quotient/chain rules, implicit differentiation.

modules.title: Calculus I — Applications of Derivatives
modules.description: Optimization, related rates, curve sketching, mean value theorem.

modules.title: Calculus I — Integrals & FTC
modules.description: Antiderivatives, definite integrals, Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, basic techniques.

modules.title: Linear Algebra — Vectors
modules.description: Vector algebra, dot & cross product, projections. Builds directly on existing 3D game-dev vector intuition.

modules.title: Linear Algebra — Systems & Matrices
modules.description: Systems of linear equations, matrices, Gaussian elimination, matrix algebra.

modules.title: Linear Algebra — Vector Spaces
modules.description: Vector spaces, linear independence, span, basis, dimension.

modules.title: Calculus II — Integration Techniques
modules.description: Substitution, integration by parts, partial fractions, trig substitution.

modules.title: Calculus II — Applications & Improper Integrals
modules.description: Volumes of revolution, arc length, improper integrals.

modules.title: Calculus II — Sequences, Series & Taylor Series
modules.description: Convergence tests, power series, Taylor/Maclaurin series.

modules.title: Calculus II — Intro Multivariable
modules.description: Partial derivatives, gradient — bridge into 2nd-year material.
